name: Shimmer
purpose: A reply that renders as it streams, with a caret and batched announcements; a shimmer for status lines.
description: A light sweep across short status text while the agent works ("Thinking…", "Searching 12 sources…"). The sweep runs through `text-ai` over `text-tertiary` every `--motion-stream-shimmer-duration` (1.8s); reduced motion shows static `text-tertiary` text.

children.notes: Figma: Label — short status text such as "Thinking…" or "Searching the web…"

active.notes: Figma: Animated — when false the text renders static (as under reduced motion).

do: Keep the label short, in sentence case, ending with an ellipsis.
Swap the shimmer for a static result as soon as the step ends ("Thought for 12s").
forbidden: Never shimmer body text, buttons or links.
Never use Shimmer as the only signal of progress for a long task — show steps or a Progress bar.
